P4b — color consolidation: before / after

The docs have a SPLIT identity today: P1–P3 moved the widgets to Radix --dm-*, but custom.css's base chrome is still Shibuya navy dark + warm light grays + Tailwind callouts. Below: current (left) vs consolidated onto --dm-* (right). The "after" column uses the real SSOT tokens.

A

Dark-theme base chrome

custom.css paints the dark base navy (#1a1a2e bg / #2a2a3e border, ×47). But the migrated widgets already use Radix dark gray (#18191b), so dark mode currently mixes navy panels with neutral-gray controls.

Before — Shibuya navy

Panel surface

Body text on a navy panel. Inline dm.style.use() chip.

TokenValue
bg#1a1a2e
border#2a2a3e

After — Radix dark gray

Panel surface

Body text on a neutral panel. Inline dm.style.use() chip.

TokenValue
bg--dm-gray-2 #18191b
border--dm-gray-a6

Recommendation: consolidate to Radix dark gray — it matches the already-migrated widgets, removing the navy/neutral split. Subtle: panels lose the blue tint and read as true neutral dark.

B

Light grays & borders

Light borders/fills use warm grays (#e4e2dd, #d5d3cc) that don't match the cool Radix gray scale the tokens define (--dm-gray-5 #e0e1e6, -6 #d9d9e0).

Before — warm gray

Content card

Hairline borders with a warm (slightly beige) cast. Inline code chip.

EdgeValue
border#e4e2dd
divider#d5d3cc

After — Radix cool gray

Content card

Hairline borders with a neutral-cool cast. Inline code chip.

EdgeValue
border--dm-gray-5
divider--dm-gray-6

Recommendation: map to --dm-gray-* (cool). The warm→cool shift is subtle in isolation but removes a third gray family and makes borders theme-adapt automatically via --dm-gray-a* alphas.

C

Callouts (warning / info / success)

Callouts use raw Tailwind colors (amber #f59e0b, sky #38bdf8, emerald #10b981) with no SSOT token. They SHOULD stay semantically colored — so the fix is to add Radix-scale status tokens, not flatten them to teal.

Before — raw Tailwind

Warning

This needs your attention.

Info

A neutral note.

Success

It worked.

After — --dm-warning / info / success

Warning

This needs your attention.

Info

A neutral note.

Success

It worked.

Recommendation: add three semantic status scales (--dm-warning-* amber, --dm-info-* blue, --dm-success-* green) to the SSOT — Radix-derived, with light+dark steps — and point the callouts at them. Keeps the meaning, kills the raw Tailwind hex. (Teal accent stays reserved for brand/interactive, not status.)

▶

Pick a direction

How aggressively to consolidate. All three keep radii (P4a done) and the teal accent (P3b done); they differ on the contested grays/dark/callouts above.

S3 · Hybridrec

Consolidate the redundant: navy dark → Radix dark, warm grays → cool --dm-gray-*. ADD semantic --dm-warning/info/success tokens for callouts. One gray family, one dark theme, status stays meaningful. Biggest SSOT win, contained visual shift.

S1 · Full Radix snap

Everything onto existing --dm-* incl. callouts flattened toward gray/teal. Smallest token surface, but loses semantic callout color — not recommended for warning/info/success.

S2 · Extend & preserve

Add warm-gray + navy-dark + status tokens so the CURRENT look is preserved, just tokenized. Largest token surface, keeps the split identity — least "통합".

After you pick, I implement it across custom.css + dynamic_ux.css (and add any new tokens to dartwork-design.css), then re-serve the live _overhaul_review.html for a final look before committing P4b.
